claude.result:
Weekly plans and the rounding change are in. The only thing left is deleting a scratch file I made in `/tmp`. That's optional, so I'll leave it unless you want it gone.

- **Weekly plans:** `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works; `w` and `weekly` are accepted too. It showed €259.57 a month, which is 59.90 × 52 ÷ 12.
- **Charge dates:** weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`. A check run with `--since 2026-10-01` and today set to 2026-10-24 listed the next charge in `renewals` as 29 Oct.
- **Rounding:** monthly costs now round to the nearest cent, so the €119.99 yearly plan shows €10.00.
- **Where it applies:** `list`, `total`, `add` and `export` all use the same calculation. `export` had its own copy of the old truncating formula, so I made it use the shared one.
- **Docs:** I updated the usage text and README, and changed the old yearly-plan test to match the rounding. I also added weekly tests. All 34 tests pass.
- **One extra fix:** `renewals` sorted by the label text ("2 Nov"), which puts "10 Nov" before "2 Nov". I changed it to sort by the real date, since weekly plans would make it show up more.

The scratch file is `/tmp/s.json`, left over from my manual check. I didn't check the CSV `export` output by hand.
